title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：religion　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 religion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the clerk ① studyed the religion that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the studying was the whole of the month. The ② religion, meaning the faith itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a religion, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ religion in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ religion at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A religion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the religion was the whole of the matter, meaning the belief and not the faith. The ⑥ religion, meaning the belief and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; religion, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a faith and a belief. He said the belief is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ religion had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ religion of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; religion, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ religion I remember is the faith described in the file, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ religion, my mother said in 1990, is the only faith that improves by being described; every religion, she said, is a belief that has agreed to look like a faith. She said the belief was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 宗教（指办事处里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 宗教（指那种宗教本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the religion 研习这一种宗教
D. n. 宗教（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 宗教之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的宗教之事）
F. n. 宗教（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 宗教、信仰（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信仰（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the religion that no applicant in the office would have described
The religion, meaning the faith itself and not the stamp
the religion at the far counter
the religion was the whole of the matter
the religion had become a line in a file
The religion of the whole thing
A religion, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: study the religion 意为“研习这一种宗教”，1981 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一种宗教做了一遍。
religion 意为“宗教”，指那种宗教本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
religion 意为“宗教”，指办事处里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
religion 意为“宗教”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
religion 意为“宗教、信仰”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种信仰就是那件事的全部。
religion 意为“信仰”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种宗教，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
religion 意为“宗教”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1986 年这一种成了卷宗里的一行。
religion 意为“宗教之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的宗教之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
religion 意为“宗教”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一种，1988 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一种。
religion 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，宗教是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的宗教。
